command:
set -eu
cg=$(cut -d: -f3 /proc/self/cgroup)
cat /proc/self/cgroup
m=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup$cg/memory.max); s=$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup$cg/memory.swap.max)
echo memory.max=$m memory.swap.max=$s
[ "$m" = 2147483648 ] && [ "$s" = 0 ]
echo SETUP_PASS
printf 'COMPUTE_ENTRY '; date -u +%FT%T.%NZ
export LEAN_PATH=.:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/LeanSearchClient/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/Qq/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/aesop/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/batteries/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/importGraph/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/mathlib/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/plausible/.lake/build/lib/lean:<local>/dev/github.com/yokoyama-lab/reversible-pebbling-lean-lowend/.lake/packages/proofwidgets/.lake/build/lib/lean
echo LEAN_PATH=$LEAN_PATH
exec <home>/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.31.0/bin/lean -j1 -M1800 -o SignatureCoverCard.olean SignatureCoverCard.lean
